 When Is Walmart Black Friday 2026? 
 This year, Walmart is going BIG for Black Friday by dropping three major sale events . The first phase of their Black Friday sale starts on Thursday, November 12th at 12:01 a.m. ET online (in stores at 6 a.m. local time) and runs through Sunday, November 15. This is considered to be their Early Black Friday event, which basically acts as a preview of what’s to come. At this time, Walmart’s Hot Deal Drops will begin for Walmart+ members to take advantage of before everyone else. These deals will open up to all shoppers on November 13th. 
 Walmart’s official Black Friday Sale starts on Sunday, November 23rd and runs through Sunday, November 29th. Like the above, Walmart+ members will have access to Hot Deal items on the first day of the sale, while everyone else can shop the remaining Hot Deals on the 24th. 
 Is Walmart Having a Cyber Monday Sale in 2026? 
 Absolutely! As mentioned before, Walmart’s Black Friday event is basically broken up into three parts, with the last being Cyber Monday. This year, Walmart’s Cyber Monday event begins at 12:01 a.m. ET on November 30th and runs through December 2nd. 
 Walmart Early Black Friday Deals Worth Shopping This Weekend (November 12-15) 
 If you’ve ever shopped Walmart’s Black Friday Sale , you may be familiar with how massive the sale is. From what we’ve seen, this year’s shopping event does not disappoint. You can pretty much find major savings across all categories, from holiday decor and home goods, to wardrobe essentials and toys for holiday gifting . Of course, you’re also sure to find deals on tech like Chromebooks, Beats, and Apple. 
 Looking for specifics? Here are a few can’t-miss deals from Walmart’s Early Black Friday Sale. 
 LEGO Minifigures Shrek Series 6-Pack Mystery Box Set , $24 (was $30)
 Gildan Unisex Heavy Blend Fleece Full Zip Hooded Sweatshirt , $14 (was $20)
 Rachael Ray 15 Piece Hard Enamel Nonstick Pots and Pans Set , $62 (was $129)
 Coach Wild Rose Eau De Parfum Spray for Women , $43 (was $80)
 VIZIO 50″ Class Quantum 4K QLED HDR Smart TV, $128
 Best Choice Products 6ft Artificial Flocked Christmas Tree w/ Twinkling Lights , $90 (was $186)
 Will NeeDoh, Pokémon Cards & Other Coveted Items Be on Sale at Walmart for Black Friday? 
 Walmart will be selling NeeDoh and Pokémon cards during their Black Friday event, in case you were looking to snag those must-have gifts ahead of the holiday season. On November 12th, Walmart will be holding a limited-time lottery , which includes Pokémon TCG 30th Celebration sets (including the UPC!), along with a ton of NeeDoh squishies. Entering the lottery does not guarantee a purchase, but at least it gives you a pretty fair shot at buying the collectible you want.
